title: How to Match a Lead » Get Matched Form
text:
## How to Match a Lead » Get Matched Form
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000009395
Inquiries sent via the " Get Matched " portal on the website will always appear as pending unless the " Automatching " add-on is enabled on the website:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12179416885/original/VJBTpDXpDP72KgsBW3I7UEYIotwtBvHX_Q.png?1779817949 | alt: ]
» Automatic Lead Matching Documentation
-----------------------
Sort through any " Pending " leads inside the Admin:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12179416912/original/x-x7NIuseI0a3Uuvd5AsBWVL_1hm33N96g.png?1779817965 | alt: ]
To confirm the source, use the Origin Page field:
*By clicking on the link after " Origin Page " the site will redirect straight to the " Get Matched " section of the website. If this form is embedded  on a custom page, then it will redirect to whichever page the website user was on when they filled out this form.*
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12179417037/original/5NWNuDlIsTnh3ae-T0I7wb3TSQc7jcMfgQ.png?1779818107 | alt: ]
In order to send this lead to the members click " Match Lead " within the " Actions " drop-down menu:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12179417058/original/NFnlFUUHB18xdF6ksxjjbzxmU0kDsVISdA.png?1779818147 | alt: ]
This will open the " Matching " portal, where a list of suggested matches will appear at the bottom of the screen:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12118606846/original/Ft9-uNQEr1zI0z1fYI69ZYjnJ2TkxXiWYQ.png?1671059320 | alt: ]
** Important Note: When matching a lead, members that have an email address @ the domain of the website are skipped as suggested matches.
A message indicating there are potential matches not included will show; hover over the help icon for a full description:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12108782906/original/etlyIV9ij_Z1iRplWAQZfRc9tgl0inOUNA.png?1652222470 | alt: ]
Please note that these members appear according to Membership Level search result priority, and must match the search criteria entered under " Match Lead #X ":
The following fields make it easy to search for other members by:
Top Level Category
Sub Level Category
Sub-sub Level Category
Name/Company
Location
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092389388/original/lWKiXTFxTaWFFk1JhkG2NuWzxeCoNI_5CQ.png?1620589789 | alt: ]
To send the lead to multiple members, click on the checkboxes of the member to send the lead email to and click on " Match ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12118606899/original/ByLn4hWgFj2i0GrD7TZFgjWI8dtQcqgH2Q.png?1671059442 | alt: ]
** When bulk matching the INDIRECT MATCH email template will be sent out to the members. **
At this time confirm this action:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086830157/original/6QDbIfMOyy6gaM8Nb9F7kBrRVQDfvUX4CA.png?1609253018 | alt: ]
Followed by a success alert:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12086037306/original/1nAiP3_zG0DaPGERnRzD4Us_cPegl7BLuw.png?1607441763 | alt: ]
The member's will instantly receive the lead in their inbox:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12074406616/original/h_xab-sQ_WwS8Dxo2fAR_kyAPy9gJQt8JA.png?1582645601 | alt: ]
The " Suggested Members" will automatically move over to the " Matched Members" and have a " Pending " status:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12118606953/original/iqdhcHrmYZiVx475CboZYjTusmIkvUV1PQ.png?1671059545 | alt: ]
NOTE: If the lead is trying to be manually set to "Pending" after the maximun number of times a lead can be accepted is reached it will set the lead as "Sold Out" and this error will show up:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128169238/original/M8WYgxT4-VKdeyI9abjTfzRJjYpgYkJDgg.png?1689053746 | alt: ]
When the lead status is changed to " Sold Out ", matched members will not be able to accept the lead as the status will get updated.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12096971256/original/bDxYcLcJjQIosVgVKj6JNaTLRaM6WLacZQ.png?1629215609 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12096971377/original/PnFY5kywhp5IYg6Ea7bcvS71_0lOnhjWjg.png?1629215714 | alt: ]
To hide the name from the member's dashboard, go into the " Website - Lead Form - Get Matched " form:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125869282/original/6ZnzwaG_TPEazLUNmsI5UiPLp_w9MkD7gA.png?1684861310 | alt: ]
Before the change:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125869165/original/514SN2d0vT2Xjw3ZlbrQbdrV1BywPPlHsA.png?1684861196 | alt: ]
After the change:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125869064/original/sc6-BW9MvTx7R2lsSvOtjI84aCpTcvX7Qw.png?1684861080 | alt: ]
